name: 2,3-methylenedioxyamphetamine
summary: 2,3-Methylenedioxyamphetamine, also known as 2,3-MDA or as ortho-MDA, is an amphetamine derivative which is mentioned in PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved) as a fairly potent and long-lasting stimulant drug, but with little or none of the entactogenic effects associated with its better-known structural isomer MDA.

pharmacology.text: 2,3-Methylenedioxyamphetamine, also known as 2,3-MDA or as ortho-MDA, is an amphetamine derivative which is mentioned in PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved) as a fairly potent and long-lasting stimulant drug, but with little or none of the entactogenic effects associated with its better-known structural isomer MDA.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is of interest mainly to researchers.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要受研究者關注。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要受研究者关注。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the substituted amphetamines, can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and, with repeated use, dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的取代安非他命可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高，反覆使用也可能造成依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的取代安非他命可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、焦虑、失眠、体温过高，反复使用也可能造成依赖。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin found that just moving MDA's ring of two oxygens one position around the benzene ring gave a stimulant with little or none of MDA's emotional effects.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin發現，只要把MDA的雙氧環在苯環上移動一個位置，就得到一種興奮劑，幾乎沒有MDA的情感作用。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin发现，只要把MDA的双氧环在苯环上移动一个位置，就得到一种兴奋剂，几乎没有MDA的情感作用。
